body:
Claim: PM loop round 9 — flight U, one pure-code card, premise-first: the card's restart condition (after 2026-09-04, zero H21 false positives in the half-state patrol since the report-only row landed) is measured first, from the live sweep's H21 row and the recorded sweep runs, with every flagged PR read and classified; only if it holds is `h21NegatedClosingKeyword` wired into the blocking gate `scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` with its own self-test cases and its own remedy string. If a false positive exists, the flight ends with the measurement and the card returns to the seat for re-triage. Graded at claim: `tooling`, `priority:p3` (the card carried no priority).
Session: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`
Branch: `claude/issue-10947-h21-gate-promotion`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-10947`
Domain: `domain:skills`
File surface: `scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` and its self-test; `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` only if the wiring needs an export it lacks — ⛔ no change to H21's predicate or its corpus; `.github/workflows/partof-closing-keyword-guard.yml` only if the gate needs an input the workflow does not pass today.
Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, opus — `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived mandate on either path.
Clause-②: no — a repo PR gate gains a refusal class; the published contract surface does not move.
Serial: no open lane PR touches either file (PR #16406 and PR #16423 on `check-half-states.mjs` are merged). Pure code ⇒ in-seat review, then the seat flips ready and arms SQUASH auto-merge; `skip-changeset`. The PR carries `Fixes #10947`.

PREMISE MEASURED FIRST, and it HOLDS: zero H21 false positives, where the card's own definition of one is a flagged PR whose sentence was in fact a correct close. Only then was anything edited. GATE SIDE ONLY: h21NegatedClosingKeyword is imported into scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs as RULE 3, a new finding kind under the EXISTING contradiction exit (a body that negates the relation it also states is the class this gate already refuses, so no new exit code). It has its own remedy string, which keeps the three safe rewordings and the backtick advice and adds that backticks are NOT the escape on the commit-message surface (that is RULE 2's). The predicate already exported the symbol, so scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs is BYTE-IDENTICAL to origin/main -- not merely 'unchanged in spirit', zero lines in the diff -- and .github/workflows/partof-closing-keyword-guard.yml is untouched because the gate needs no input the workflow does not already pass. Disjointness is free: a number already declared Part of is RULE 1's row and the predicate skips it, so one card number can never be reported by two rules. The clean verdict line now says RULE 3 was judged too, so a run that judged one surface cannot present itself as one that judged all. THE FINDING THAT MATTERS MOST: the premise sweep turned up a SECOND SPECIMEN of the original incident, after the report-only row landed. PR #11746's body said an adjacent finding had been filed rather than repaired, bound a closing keyword to that card in the same sentence, and card #11745 went to completed TWO SECONDS after the merge (15:33:58Z merge, 15:34:00Z close, 2026-08-24). #11745 is labelled bug + domain:spec, still carries pm:queue, and describes a real unfixed defect; it has read as finished ever since. The patrol could not have caught it: that PR was open for 41 minutes, entirely between the 13:56Z and 19:48Z sweeps. A six-hourly report-only row is STRUCTURALLY blind to a short-lived PR and no schedule fixes that -- which is the measured case for the promotion this card asked for, rather than an argument for it. NO STATE WAS TOUCHED on #11745: a state this flight did not set belongs to another actor, so it is reported for the seat to judge. PR #16444 is DRAFT, skip-changeset applied additively and read back, CI fully converged GREEN (34 check runs, 23 success / 11 skipped / 0 failures). Not flipped ready, not enqueued, not approved -- the seat does that at ACCEPT.",
  "tests": "All local verification at final commit 90c2b5dacf (BASE ac76425f0b); every exit captured BEFORE any pipe (redirect-then-capture), every verdict quoted from the gate's own line. (1) PREMISE, measured two ways as ruled. (a) LIVE SWEEP now: node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs read-only against objectstack-ai/objectstack (REST probe 200 first) -> EXIT=0, 306 half-states over 439 pm-labelled cards and 30 open PRs, and ZERO H21 rows. The newest recorded run agrees in the form that names the family explicitly: the patrol anchor body written by run 34055667490 (swept 2026-09-06T19:46:09Z) lists H21 among the families that 'were EVALUATED and found nothing'. (b) RECORDED RUNS: 64 Live half-state sweep runs on main since PR #10939 merged 2026-08-21T20:09:43Z -- oldest 2026-08-22T02:05:12Z, newest 2026-09-06T19:41:09Z, every one completed/success. Two channels shut, neither expiry, and NOTHING is padded with recall. SUBSTITUTE, STATED AS ONE and strictly WIDER than what it replaces: H21 reads the OPEN PR listing at sweep time, so anything those 64 runs could have flagged was a PR open at some point in the window. That population was enumerated in full via repo-scoped REST -- every currently open PR plus every PR closed with activity after the row landed -- 2,285 PRs, 2,285 non-empty bodies, created_at 2026-08-20T13:02:51Z..2026-09-07T00:27:44Z, each body run through the SHIPPED predicate imported from the worktree rather than a re-implementation. H21 FLAGS 3, FALSE POSITIVES 0. Classified: PR #11746, sentence 'One adjacent finding filed rather than fixed: [card 11745]' = SPECIMEN, true positive, and it cost card #11745 (see summary). PR #14524, sentence '...is walked deliberately, not as an afterthought: a scan omitting it reports 0 cycles on the pre-fix [card 13513]' = TRUE NEGATION -- not a close at all, correct or otherwise (that PR closes #14195, and #13513 had been closed by a human a day earlier). PR #15738, sentence 'The person still cannot register a login, because per the 2026-09-02 ruling recorded on closed [card 14349]' = TRUE NEGATION -- a reference to a card already closed not_planned three days before. Neither of the latter two is a correct close that H21 refused, so neither is a false positive under the card's definition; both bind a keyword to a card the sentence merely refers to, and in both the named card was already closed at merge time, so the parser had nothing left to close -- luck, not correctness, and one pair of backticks is the remedy. (2) SELF-TEST: 66 -> 83 cases. 17 new cases in one registered battery, roster floor 15 -> 16. pnpm check:partof-closing-keyword -> EXIT=0, 'check-partof-closing-keyword self-test: 83 cases pass.' (3) ABLATION, committed FIRST so the restore leg had an implementation to point at. The one call was replaced with a constant. MUTATION PROVED ON DISK BEFORE THE RUN, not by the editor's exit code: removed-text grep 1 -> 0 occurrences, injected-text grep 1, blob 03724543a3 -> feedd0bb22. Script carried trap restore EXIT INT TERM against an ABSOLUTE path. ABLATED -> EXIT=1, 'check-partof-closing-keyword self-test: 9 of 83 case(s) failed' -- exactly the predicted set: both specimens, the no-forked-rule check, and all six remedy pins. RESTORED via git checkout HEAD -- <abs path> -> blob back to 03724543a3, git diff HEAD EMPTY for that path, injected-text grep 0 / call grep 1, then EXIT=0, 83 cases pass. Restore proved by STATE, never by an exit code. This gate has no build step, so no dist preflight applies; there is no stale artifact to fool the run. (4) AGAINST REAL PR BODIES, both from the H21 reading: PR #11746 (flagged, real body) -> EXIT=1 and the output names the card, quotes the sentence and offers the three rewordings plus the backtick escape; PR #16429 (real control) -> EXIT=0. Had this gate existed on 2026-08-24, PR #11746 would have gone red and card #11745 would still be open. (5) THIS PR'S OWN BODY was run through the new gate before it was posted -> EXIT=0. Every specimen sentence in the body is inside backticks or a fence, so the body cannot re-close any of the cards it discusses. (6) GATE UNION derived AFTER the final commit: node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack, no path arguments, change set re-derived from the merge base -> 1 path, 31 commands. ALL 31 RUN, ALL EXIT 0. Reconciled: --ran -> EXIT=0, 'dispatch-gates --ran: 31 derived famil(ies) accounted for -- 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.' (7) RULED EXTRAS: node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test -> EXIT=0, 'check-half-states self-test: 2636 cases pass.' (2636 UNCHANGED; the file is not touched at all). pnpm check:pm-clause2-carriers -> EXIT=0, 'check-clause2-carriers self-test: 190 cases pass'. node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test on the FINAL file list -> EXIT=0, 'NOT governed -- ordinary queue landing applies to a PR with exactly this file list.' pnpm check:nul-bytes -> EXIT=0, plus a direct control-byte scan of the edited file, grep_exit=1, no matches. (8) WHOLE-REPO pnpm lint (eslint . --no-inline-config) through scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh, slot issue-10947, acquired once and held: 'VERDICT command-exit 0 - held the lock 86s - waited 0s'. No narrowing was needed, so none is claimed. Shared-box seconds, per the wrapper's own caveat. (9) FIRST MISSTEP, CORRECTED AND RECORDED: my first two attempts at the extra gates used wrong script paths and died MODULE_NOT_FOUND (exit 1). That is not a red gate -- it never reached a gate body -- so it was re-run under the real pnpm check:* names above rather than written down as a failed measurement. (10) CI ON THE HEAD, polled in the FOREGROUND to convergence as this card's dispatch required: 34 check runs on 90c2b5dacf -- 23 success, 11 skipped, 0 failures, 0 incomplete. (11) DELIVERY READ-BACKS: PR body read back in full -- prose byte-identical to what was sent, the only delta being the platform's own appended attribution footer (the documented create-time behaviour), so the sanitizer ate nothing. skip-changeset written through the ADDITIVE labels endpoint and confirmed by COMPARISON read-back (before [], target skip-changeset, after [skip-changeset], union minus read-back EMPTY = nothing stripped); re-read after CI, still present alongside the size labeler's size/m. PR still draft, mergeable_state clean. Worktree removed WITHOUT --force, which is itself the proof nothing was left uncommitted.",

Whether GitHub's own parser fires there could NOT be measured, so it is unknown whether H21 is marginally wider than the parser it models. Now that the rule is blocking, that width is a hard red rather than a patrol line.",

        "A. Leave the predicate exactly as it is and keep this as a watched unknown.       "recommendation": "A now, B as its own small card. Real business pull: near zero either way -- one body in 2,285, and its named card was already closed, so nobody has yet been taxed by this. AI-error resistance: A and B keep the loud refusal; C is the tolerance direction, and a quiet miss on this surface silently closes a card, which is exactly the harm class. Startup-stage focus: A costs nothing today, C spends a predicate change plus a corpus re-run on a shape nobody has hit, and B is one throwaway PR. C is not recommended at any confidence level -- it is out of this card's surface by ruling AND it is the only option that could make the gate quieter on a real defect."

        "C. Stop and ask before writing any case."
      ],
      "recommendation": "A, which is what shipped. Both readings are true statements about the gate, both are cheap to pin, and neither can be the wrong thing to assert -- so the ambiguity costs two extra cases rather than a round trip, and C would have stopped a flight over a question that resolves itself by covering both. Flagged here only so the seat can confirm the reading was not narrowed."

Recommend the seat reopen it. NO state, label or assignee was touched here.",
